hooks.command: bash -c 'if ! clai --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[clai] WARNING: clai is not installed. The django-engineer skill cannot be loaded. See README.agents.md (Step 1a) to install clai."; elif ! find .claude/skills -maxdepth 1 -name "django-engineer*" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo "[clai] WARNING: django-engineer skill is not installed. Run: clai skill install django-engineer --target claude-code"; else echo "[clai] OK: django-engineer skill is available."; fi'
